name: Genie Assistant
description: SAP Analytics Cloud custom widget for communicating with a Databricks Genie backend.

backendUrl.description: URL of the Databricks Flask application.

workspaceHost.description: Databricks workspace host used for OAuth authentication.

clientId.description: Databricks OAuth service principal client ID.

clientSecret.description: Databricks OAuth service principal client secret.

accessToken.description: Optional manually supplied Databricks OAuth access token. Used as a legacy fallback.

askGenie.description: Send a natural-language question to Databricks Genie.

getSessionId.description: Get the current Genie session ID.

getBackendUrl.description: Get the configured Databricks backend URL.

setAccessToken.description: Set the Databricks OAuth access token.

getAccessToken.description: Get the current Databricks OAuth access token.

getWorkspaceHost.description: Get the configured Databricks workspace host.

setClientId.description: Set the Databricks OAuth client ID.

getClientId.description: Get the configured Databricks OAuth client ID.

setClientSecret.description: Set the Databricks OAuth client secret.

getClientSecret.description: Get the configured Databricks OAuth client secret.

getOauthScope.description: Get the configured Databricks OAuth scope.

onMessageSent.description: Fired when a question is sent to the backend.

onResponseReceived.description: Fired when a Genie response is received.
